Corning Incorporated is an innovator in glass, ceramic, and materials science, including optical communications solutions. The Division Digital Software Engineer will design, develop, and implement digital solutions across manufacturing plants, leading projects that reduce costs while improving quality and process capability. The role partners with manufacturing, supply chain, finance, and engineering teams to deploy digital, automation, vision, and process control technologies.
Manufacturing
No H1B
Responsibilities
Design, develop, and implement solutions for manufacturing which leverage latest digital technologies including data analytics and programming technologies, and work closely with manufacturing to define appropriate controls hardware platforms/systems for implementing process control solutions
Develop in-depth knowledge of existing processes to identify process control optimization opportunities and write proposals to initiate cross-functional projects
Work with experienced professionals in manufacturing and multi-disciplined team processes subject matter experts, and apply process data analysis skills to gain fundamental understanding of manufacturing processes
Utilize statistical analysis to design for process capability
Lead projects and work in a multi-disciplinary research, development, and engineering environment to identify opportunities for digital business transformation
Facilitate the transfer of new process control technologies and methodologies into manufacturing and provide training to manufacturing and engineering personnel
Document process control findings and newly implemented technologies in technical reports and functional specifications. Generate intellectual property through invention disclosures and patent applications

Required
BS in Computer Science, Computer Engineering, or Electrical Engineering
Programming experience in Python, C#, HTML, and JavaScript
Programming-related skills related to or involving web development, .NET, Flask, Microsoft IIS, Visual Studio, Git
Analysis/Reporting experience with tools such as SQL Server Reporting Services (SSRS), SQL, PowerBI
Ability to work in a manufacturing environment
Experience in practical application of process control, including process data analysis, system modeling/identification, and control loop design/tuning
Strong verbal and written skills, able to prepare and present proposals effectively with and across multiple organizations
Experience in statistical analysis methods, and Lean-Optimization (e.g., Six Sigma/DMAIC)
Experience with ChatGPT and RAG implementations
Familiarity with a diverse array of process controls technologies such as model predictive, multi-variable, non-linear approaches, and classic PID control
Machine vision experience including algorithm development, coding, and use of industrial cameras/vision
This position does not support immigration sponsorship
Preferred
Minimum 1+ years industry experience (preferred within manufacturing), with a track record of automation and/or optimization project implementation

Matching contributions to Corning’s 401(k) savings plan, with total contributions to retirement accounts reaching between 7% and 12% of pay depending on age and years of service.
